description: Starter fixture for inspect-drawing Phase 1, scoped to 1700 S. Lamar. Two motivating examples carried over from the design plan, with TBD documentId/sheetNum slots that need to be populated by hand-curation from a prior cc run before this fixture is replay-ready.

source.notes: Hand-curated from prior cc runs in winston/workspaces/cc-audit/ and winston/workspaces/variance-testing/cc/1700-S-Lamar/. Both example test cases below are placeholders — documentId and sheetNum still need to be filled in.

testCases.question: Do the wastewater lines have direction-of-flow arrows on the line itself, not just nearby callouts?

_provenance.notes: Carried over from motivating-examples.md. Generic vision tool answers this inconsistently because adjacent lines and callouts confuse the model. Replay this case once Phase 1 is wired up to confirm the cropped drawing block helps.

testCases.question: Are adjacent driveways depicted along the street frontages? Look for elongated U shapes or small J shapes indicating curb-return curves on the neighboring parcels.
testCases.regionHint: along the street frontages outside the project property line

_provenance.notes: Carried over from motivating-examples.md. Subtle-pattern recognition test case — driveway curb returns are easy to miss. Good Phase 3 candidate for per-question reference images.
